device.name: Tecan Fluent liquid handler through FluentControl (tecan_fluent.tecan_ctrl.Tecan)

facts.text: Tecan is the entry class; its constructor attaches to a running FluentControl and keeps the runtime controller in self.rt
run_command raises when the API channel is not open and otherwise sends the command with ExecuteCommand
liha_aspirate builds Object_LihaAspirateScriptCommandDataV5 from volumes, selected tips, labware, selected wells and a liquid class
liha_dispense builds LihaDispenseScriptCommandDataV4 from the same fields
liha_mix builds Object_LihaMixScriptCommandDataV4 with n_cycles and the volume list
mca_aspirate takes a float volume, a labware and a liquid class and builds Object_Mca384AspirateScriptCommandDataV2
mca_dispense takes a float volume, a labware and a liquid class and builds Object_Mca384DispenseScriptCommandDataV2
The LiHa pipetting command data requires exactly eight volumes and raises ValueError otherwise
The LiHa well-selection element hardcodes the 96-well names from range(1, 12+1) over ABCDEFGH
A 96-well name maps to a Tecan well number as i_col * 8 + i_row
The README examples give wellname96_to_tecan_well_no('A1') -> 0 and ('B1') -> 1
The RuntimeController provides StopMethod and GetFluentStatus
The library targets the Tecan.VisionX.API.V2 .NET library and expects FluentControl under C:/Program Files (x86)/Tecan/FluentControl
The author used the library on a Tecan Fluent 1080 system
The MCA path supports only whole-plate pipetting; partial tip mounting with an offset is not implemented
